samples:
Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Being mad and not really wanting to talk to my father after what happened / Telling my sister to pound sand

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Bumping my music when driving / Aggressively demanding an apology from my wife

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Wanting to cut my sister off / Not giving a good enough New Year's kiss

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to sleep with my mother / Refusing to see my aging grandma, even though she's never done anything horrible to me

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not letting my gf blow my secrets / Disowning my mom

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Getting mad at my sister for wanting to get food after we've already left / Not wanting my Great Aunt to come to my birthday celebration

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to get to know my dead beat dad / Quitting earlier than I said I would

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not placing a disabled kid on a pedestal because he has cerebral palsy / Planning to move away for college even though my mother has health issues

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Judging my parents and siblings for bawling their eyes out at my grandma's funeral / Not wanting to spend large amounts of time on a gift

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Using my stepmom cheating on my dad as leverage / Refusing to pay extra down-payment for an apartment

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to get back with my ex-girlfriend and raise the baby together because she is pregnant / Not wanting to contact grandparents that disowned me

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not paying as many bills as my husband / Asking why my SIL wanted a blank check from my mother

child.label: Family Stories: Who's Wrong
child.description: Questions about who is at fault in a longer first-person story about a family conflict, or which of two described family-related actions is less ethical.
child.not_for: One-sentence scenarios about a family member judged clearly wrong or not (use Family Action Judgments).
examples: Based on this story about my sister's wedding, who is in the wrong?
Which is less ethical: skipping my dad's birthday or reading my mom's texts?

child.label: Family Action Judgments
child.description: Questions about whether a narrator's action toward a family member in a one-sentence first-person scenario is clearly wrong.
child.not_for: Longer stories asking who is in the wrong, or comparisons of two actions (use Family Stories: Who's Wrong).
examples: Is it wrong that I used my mom's vet money for gambling?
Is it wrong that I let my toddler play alone by the pool?
